plugins.name: ops-cycle
plugins.description: The ops role's state machine: idle -> readiness -> rollout -> steady -> incident. A UserPromptSubmit hook mints an approval token only from the user's own turn; a PreToolUse gate refuses readiness -> rollout without every checklist item resolved to yes/no with a pointable artifact, refuses rollout -> steady without a matching approval token, and mechanically refuses any release transition out of steady once the error budget is recorded exhausted.

plugins.name: ops-agent-env
plugins.description: One-install environment bundle for the ops role: installs ops-cycle via dependency. Contains no code of its own.
